acceptance_examples: A fresh checkout installs a strict three-package workspace and passes root gates.
CI runs lint, typecheck, test, and build on pull requests and initial pushes.
A Changesets workflow opens or updates a Version Packages PR without requesting npm publishing credentials.
The built authmd CLI honors documented flags, reporters, and exit codes.
A valid auth.md passes and malformed documents produce stable actionable findings.
Conformant discovery metadata passes and inconsistent metadata reports cited paths.
A read-only check produces deterministic reports and opt-in probe traces.
The composite action consumes a pinned CLI and publishes report outputs and summary.
Service discovery endpoints and typed persistence surface valid metadata.
Anonymous, service-auth, and assertion identities receive stable safe responses.
Claim state transitions enforce code, polling, rate limit, and expiry rules.
JWKS, signed assertions, and replay checks reject unsafe JOSE inputs.
Token exchange narrows scope and resource target with OAuth errors.
Revocation is idempotent and event delivery is retryable without secret logs.
Local service deployment configuration and the demo flow are reproducible.
The completion-grant spec defines fields, transitions, errors, and a worked flow.
The broker atomically downscopes, binds DPoP, and allows exactly one consume.
Completion and TTL finalization are idempotent with policy and evidence.
SDK and middleware complete safely and reject invalid protected calls.
The threat model maps high-severity risks to negative evidence.

tracks.reason: GitHub branch protection, npm publication and consumer installation, and a live Cloudflare deployment require external authority or credentials. They are not represented as local passes.
No real GitHub policy, npm publication, or Cloudflare deployment is available in this local reference validation.
This v0 reference has programmatic APIs, a CLI, and a composite action but no graphical interface; command/action rendering is exercised by acceptance tests.
